jobs.title: Lead Strategic Planning Manager - Capacity & Workforce
jobs.description:
This is a full-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.

Overall Purpose: Manage sales capacity strategy and workforce planning, including seller capacity models, coverage planning, role architecture, and workforce investment recommendations; align sales resources with market opportunities and business growth objectives to improve customer coverage, seller productivity, and organizational efficiency.

Key Roles and Responsibilities: Typical tasks may include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Strategic Capacity and Workforce Planning: Develop short- and long-term workforce plans, capacity requirements, coverage ratios, and staffing strategies aligned with revenue growth, productivity, customer coverage, and cost-efficiency objectives.
- Workforce Forecasting and Scenario Modeling: Build forecasting models incorporating revenue targets, productivity assumptions, attrition, hiring plans, and market opportunities; conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to guide resource allocation and investment decisions.
- Role Architecture and Coverage Design: Define seller personas, role responsibilities, engagement models, productivity assumptions, and workload standards; design coverage and territory structures that align resources with customer potential and market opportunity.
- Performance Analysis and Executive Insights: Analyze attainment, productivity, utilization, customer coverage, and workforce investment returns; translate findings into executive recommendations that improve staffing, seller effectiveness, and sales performance.
- Cross-Functional Leadership and Governance: Partner with Sales Leadership, Finance, HR, Transformation, and Sales Operations to align workforce assumptions, establish capacity-planning governance, support organizational change, and influence strategic workforce decisions.

Job Contribution: An experienced professional recognized as an expert in sales capacity strategy and workforce planning, creatively resolving complex business and resource-allocation issues through advanced analytics and strategic judgment. Leads significant planning initiatives with substantial autonomy, develops long-term workforce and coverage strategies, and influences executive decisions regarding staffing, investment, role design, and organizational effectiveness. Collaborates extensively with senior leadership and provides guidance to less experienced professionals.

Supervisor: No

Education/Experience: Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Analytics, or a related field desired; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 8+ years of related experience in workforce planning, sales strategy, sales operations, finance, management consulting, or business planning. Experience developing capacity models, coverage plans, resource-allocation frameworks, and analytics-driven executive recommendations preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Programs & Governance
jobs.description:
This is a full-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.

About the Job
Build what connects us—and shape what comes next. At AT&T, the strength of our network begins with the facilities and infrastructure behind it. In this highly visible role, you’ll help define how critical building systems are designed, governed, and delivered across our national real estate portfolio.

You’ll have the opportunity to set enterprise MEP building standards, lead nationwide compliance programs, and influence high-impact infrastructure and real estate initiatives. Working with project managers, technical experts, and senior leaders, you’ll drive solutions that improve safety, reliability, performance, and value at scale.

What You’ll Do
Engineering Standards & Governance
- Shape and continuously improve enterprise-wide MEP building standards that support AT&T’s evolving business needs.

- Create governance that raises the bar for consistency, quality, reliability, and operational performance across capital and expense programs.

- Bring engineering, architecture, construction, facilities, and operations teams together around clear design criteria and best practices.

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor on building systems, lifecycle planning, infrastructure reliability, and engineering risk.

Compliance Program Leadership
- Lead national compliance programs that protect our people, facilities, and operations while meeting engineering, life-safety, regulatory, and building-code requirements.

- Turn reviews, audits, and performance insights into clear corrective actions and measurable results.

- Champion improvements that reduce risk, strengthen reliability, and unlock greater operational efficiency.

Program & Portfolio Management
- Own a portfolio of enterprise initiatives tied to AT&T’s most important business priorities.

- Drive end-to-end execution across budgets, schedules, scope, milestones, SLAs, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting.

- Build scalable governance processes, metrics, templates, standards, and documentation that make teams more effective.

- Partner with a national team of project managers to deliver critical engineering, compliance, and infrastructure initiatives on time and within budget.

- Use designated AI tools to simplify workflows, strengthen analysis, and create effective process and training materials.

Stakeholder Leadership
- Collaborate with senior leaders to set priorities and align resources to business goals.

- Translate complex program, risk, and financial information into clear recommendations for executive audiences.

- Build alignment across functions and inspire adoption of stronger governance and execution practices.

What You’ll Bring
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Architectural Engineering; Construction Management; or a related field preferred.

- 8+ years of experience in MEP engineering, facilities management, construction, or infrastructure program management.

- Experience leading national portfolios and governance programs.

- Strong knowledge of building codes, life-safety requirements, and facilities operations.

- PE, CFM, PMP, or a related professional certification preferred.

Ready to make an impact at scale? Bring your technical expertise, strategic mindset, and leadership to AT&T—and help build the standards and infrastructure that keep our business moving forward.
